defects.summary: All 246 L2–9 hooks replaced: structural German „{Name}: Grad N, {Schule} — {Zeit}, {Reichweite}.“ (e.g. Säurepfeil: Grad 2, Hervorrufung — Aktion, 27 Meter.). No „SRD-Zauber Grad N“ placeholders remain. Not yet L0–L1 flavor hooks, but satisfies option B hook slot.

EN/DE word-salad hybrid eliminated (0/246 hits for „You Berührung“, „against the Ziel“, „On a failed save“, „muss einen dexterity-Rettungswurf“, etc.). Descriptions use German structural preamble + labeled „Kernwirkung:“ English SRD lead sentence — acceptable per option B waiver.
0/246 L2–9 entries with name === nameEn (was 121). All display names German (e.g. Eingebung, Prismawand, Wahre Auferstehung). Final re-review verified programmatically.

Keys migrated to English snake_case (acid_arrow, warding_bond) — kebab-case resolved, 0 kebab keys. Still diverge from L0–L1 German snake_case convention (schmierfett, heilendes_wort); no documented bilingual key map. Non-blocking for option B approval.

Lowercase ability hybrids gone from descriptions. Kernwirkung English uses standard SRD phrasing (e.g. „dexterity saving throw“) where abilities appear; no „dexterity-Rettungswurf“ / „wisdom-Rettungswurf“ mixes.

`range` fields localized to meters/Selbst/Berührung on most entries; 8 duration fields still „Until dispelled“; castingTime retains English clauses (counterspell reaction text, commune); Kernwirkung/materials retain feet/miles/inches (Prismatic Wall „1 inch“, Meteorenschwarm „1 mile“ range) — Kernwirkung imperial deferred per option B waiver; metadata fields still need DE pass.
Material component strings left in raw English (e.g. „Powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach.“) — L0–L1 localize materials to German.

Attribution mismatch: import note and dev-progress/spells-l2-l9-import.json cite Open5e wotc-srd (2014-era text) but every entry tags `SRD_SOURCE` whose `book` is „SRD 5.2.1“. Mechanics prose may differ from 2024 SRD; document actual source generation or re-import from 5.2.1 when available.
Shard headers now state structural DE + Kernwirkung pattern; German display names on all 246 L2–9 entries (S-03 closed).
